questions: Should the Hann window be applied to the complex wave as a whole (multiplying the complex array) or separately to the real and imaginary parts before combining?
What should happen if the time input is empty (size 0)? Should it return empty arrays and an empty plot, raise an error, or something else?
Is the frequency parameter allowed to be negative, and if so, how should it affect the wave (e.g., negative frequency meaning opposite rotation)?
Should the time parameter be assumed to be a 1D numpy array, or could it be a list or other sequence? If other types, should they be converted?
What units are assumed for the time array (e.g., seconds)? This affects the interpretation of frequency (Hz vs rad/s).
Should the plot include a grid, specific line colors, or other stylistic elements beyond the required title, labels, and legend?
Is the amplitude parameter allowed to be complex, and if so, how should it be combined with the complex exponential?
Should the function raise an error if amplitude or frequency are not numeric (e.g., strings), or should it attempt to convert?
